// RED fixture for `flow-determinism` — the lint MUST reject this.
// @workflow-body
// A workflow body reads the raw clock and a raw RNG, bypassing the deterministic WfCtx surface:
// replay diverges (the non-deterministic-replay bug class) (index 9.2, OQ-F).
pub async fn approval_workflow(ctx: &mut WfCtx) {
    let started = SystemTime::now();
    let nonce = Uuid::new_v4();
    let _ = (started, nonce);
}
